note: l5_valaskjalf at checkpoint 7067 on the wide ledge beyond the fourth hammer. The floor (z -8217) runs level to the chamber block's face at y -93708 (the unit's render terrain has the same 790-high face: the steps start on the block); a running jump catches its edge, ledge band 1542 (z -7427). Up the steps volumes 6872 / 6866 start 250_val_hammer (6846), whose end gives wp_thorhammer and starts chapter 6.
